report_name: Owner of Ransomware Recovery Firm Charged with Wire Fraud

identities.name: Zohar Pinhasi
identities.description: The owner of MonsterCloud, a U.S. and Israeli national, who was indicted by the U.S. Department of Justice on wire fraud charges for allegedly deceiving ransomware victims.

identities.name: MonsterCloud
identities.description: A Florida-based ransomware recovery company that allegedly engaged in a scheme to defraud ransomware victims by secretly paying ransoms while claiming to use proprietary decryption technology.

identities.name: U.S. Department of Justice
identities.description: The U.S. government agency that charged Zohar Pinhasi with wire fraud.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
identities.description: A U.S. federal agency mentioned in the report for its official guidance strongly advising against paying ransoms.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: A U.S. federal agency mentioned in the report for its official guidance strongly advising against paying ransoms.

identities.name: MonsterCloud Clients
identities.description: Victims of ransomware attacks who hired MonsterCloud for recovery services and were allegedly deceived into paying for a service under false pretenses.
